description: This is a Perl script designed as a utility for flashing firmware onto a Linksys ADSL2MUE device. It includes network socket operations for device discovery over UDP, FTP communication for firmware transfer, and script logic for partition handling and firmware upload.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with additional methods tailored for interacting with the ADAM2 device, including commands for environment variables, reboot, and login customization.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends a USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public interface to retrieve environment variables.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Issues a reboot command over FTP.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device via FTP command and closes connection.
